first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The only visible person in a spacesuit, wearing a white extravehicular suit, a transparent visor, red bands around the legs, and a large white backpack.

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: The blue-white celestial-body surface behind the foreground person and equipment, with a light-blue curved bright edge.

entities.name: black outer-space background
entities.identification: The nearly uniform black distant background beyond the foreground subjects and the bright edge of the planet.

entities.name: gold foil-covered equipment assembly
entities.identification: An equipment assembly with wrinkled gold panel surfaces, box-shaped protrusions, dark recesses, and silver handrails.

entities.name: silver-blue cylindrical module section
entities.identification: Retaining the shared module-section identity, in this clip it is mainly visible as a silver end face with fine texture, a dark curved edge, and a wide gold band.

entities.name: gray-blue curved panel surface
entities.identification: The broad, curved, light gray-blue band-like panel surface behind the gold equipment, with rectangular subdivisions and dark and light patches on its surface.

At frame 0, Person A wears a thick, bulky white extravehicular suit; a transparent domed visor, two white gloves, and part of a large white backpack are visible. The sleeves and legs have dense folds, there are red bands around the legs, and a small light-colored box is at the side of the waist. The visor has bright reflections, with part of the facial outline visible inside; the glove knuckles and dark palm surfaces are discernible, and gray frame bars and connectors are partially visible on the backpack.

At frame 0, the gold foil-covered equipment assembly has wrinkled gold panel surfaces, box-shaped protrusions, dark rectangular recesses, and silver handrails. The foil surfaces are densely covered with wrinkles, bright reflective spots, and folded seams; a curved, gold-covered strip-like component is visible on the upper part; the lower panel surface is fitted with narrow black connectors and a light-colored horizontal bar; and the edges have silver-gray metal frames and support tabs.

At frame 0, only a short curved edge of the silver circular end face of the silver-blue cylindrical module section is exposed, showing fine stripes and bright reflections, with a narrow dark border around the outer edge; the rest is occluded by the gold foil-covered equipment assembly or lies outside the image.

At frame 0, the planetary background exposes a bright, curved blue-white surface above Person A, with white cloud patterns and light-blue areas locally visible; its edge forms a thin, bright-blue arc adjoining the black distant background.

At frame 0, the black outer-space background is nearly uniform deep black and is distributed along the bright edge of the planetary background and through the gaps between Person A's arms and the gold foil-covered equipment assembly.
At frame 0, the gray-blue curved panel surface is light gray-blue and exposes a relatively broad, curved, band-like region in the lower right of the image.

At frame 21, Person A's side and back face the camera; Person A wears a white extravehicular suit and carries a large white rectangular backpack. The sleeves and legs have dense folds, both legs have red bands, a small light-colored box is at the side of the waist, and dark and metallic-colored components are exposed along the side edge of the torso. A gray frame, dark grooves, strap-like connectors, and an exterior box-shaped protrusion are visible on the backpack, and the glove wrists have gray ring-shaped structures.

At frame 21, the gold foil-covered equipment assembly exposes a box-shaped component, a wrinkled gold surface, a dark rectangular recess, and a horizontal support tab in the lower right of the image, with bright folded surfaces along the edges; the assembly's silver handrail is partially exposed along the bottom edge of the image and is cropped.

At frame 21, the silver circular end face of the silver-blue cylindrical module section occupies the upper-right region of the image, and its surface has dense, fine parallel lines and bright and dark reflective bands. A wide gold band crosses the end face diagonally, with rows of small dark dots visible on the band; the edge of the end face has a narrow dark frame and light-colored rectangular protruding tabs.

At frame 21, the planetary background exposes a bright blue-white surface behind Person A and the silver-blue cylindrical module section; irregular white cloud patterns, a light-blue base color, and a thin, bright-blue curved edge are locally visible, with the bright edge extending between the two.

At frame 21, the black outer-space background is nearly uniform deep black and is exposed below Person A and between the structures, adjoining the bright-blue edge of the planetary background, Person A's white clothing, and the outline of the gold foil-covered equipment assembly.
